title: 存錢買遊戲機
question: 小明想買一台遊戲機，每週存一樣多的零用錢。請輸入遊戲機的價格、每週存多少元，輸出要存幾週才夠。

test_case.note: 存 3 週 900 不夠，第 4 週 1200 才夠

en.title: Save for a Game
en.question: Ming wants a game console. He saves the same money every week. Input the price and the money per week. Output how many weeks he needs.

test_case.note: 3 weeks is 900, not enough. 4 weeks is 1200
